experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.asm: fdiv.d $f0, $f0, $f1; fdiv.d $f0, $f0, $f1; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 2000 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; li.d $r4, 4607182418800017408; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; li.d $r5, -1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'fdiv.d $f0, $f0, $f1; fdiv.d $f0, $f0, $f1; movfr2gr.d $r4, $f0; and $r4, $r4, $r5; or $r4, $r4, $r6; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4'

latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency: 8 cycles for special values; 10 for 1/1 and 1/2; 23 for general quotients and max/1; 9 for max/minnorm or minnorm/max; 24 for maxsub/1 and 1/maxsub. Measured with an integer-bit reset chain; 5 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. The sample experiment uses 1.0.

throughput.asm: fdiv.d $f0, $f16, $f17; fdiv.d $f1, $f16, $f17; fdiv.d $f2, $f16, $f17; fdiv.d $f3, $f16, $f17; fdiv.d $f4, $f16, $f17; fdiv.d $f5, $f16, $f17; fdiv.d $f6, $f16, $f17; fdiv.d $f7, $f16, $f17

throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes, subnormal or widest operands: 100.00 cycles for 8 independent lanes, 12.5 CPI (0.08 IPC); the same body on LA664 measures 5.5 CPI.

notes: Latency model: 8 cycles for special operands, 10 when the divisor is a power of two (the stored sample uses 1.0/1.0), 23 for a general divisor, up to +1 with a subnormal operand. The stored experiment runs the division twice, so cycles = (core_cycles - 6) / 2. 64-bit vector lanes match the scalar numbers and run in parallel (slowest lane dominates); 32-bit vector lanes cost 2 x scalar - 5.
